concerns.text: Task T007 bundles several distinct activities (running three static analysis tools, memory monitoring, normalization, and PairOutcome construction) into a single item. This is too coarse for deterministic execution; it should be split into separate tasks (e.g., T007a – run Semgrep, T007b – run SonarQube, T007c – run Bandit, T007d – normalize findings, T007e – construct PairOutcome) so each has a clear deliverable and verification.

FR-012 requires confirming that the dataset provides ≥ 80 % statistical power for detecting an odds‑ratio ≈ 2.0. No task explicitly performs or verifies this power analysis after the data is collected. Add a task (e.g., T016 – Validate statistical power) that computes the achieved power using the final sample size and reports whether it meets the ≥ 80 % threshold, with verification that the power value is recorded and meets the criterion.
